verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents built-in sign-in with external OAuth providers, support for custom OAuth/OIDC providers, and managed sessions with refresh tokens and rotation, so developers don't hand-roll the token protocol. However, the evidence never mentions the authorization code flow with PKCE, and a community report says the OAuth flow on React Native/Expo needed Expo AuthSession and lacked a guide. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of authorization-code-with-PKCE support, OIDC flow details, and coverage beyond web platforms (e.g., mobile OAuth guides).

support.subject: As a developer, I can implement standard OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows (authorization code with PKCE, refresh tokens) without hand-rolling protocol details
